note: Higher-priced mortgage loan definition plus the escrow requirement and its exemptions. Spread tiers are structural statutory percentages: APOR+1.5pp standard first lien, +2.5pp jumbo first lien, +3.5pp subordinate lien; unchanged since 2014 and not indexed. The escrow requirement reaches first-lien higher-priced transactions only. The four-leg small-originator exemption is CONJUNCTIVE and its fourth leg is a restriction; the common-interest-community master-policy exemption is LIMITED to insurance premiums and never reaches property taxes. The two asset limits are indexed annually and carried as dated table entries; the two transaction counts (2,000 transferred first-lien covered transactions; 1,000 first-lien principal-dwelling covered transactions including portfolio) are fixed statutory figures. golden_hash pinned (see vectors).
